moments.title: The Hundred Finals Day

angles.copy: It's Finals Day for The Hundred this Sunday! Who's lifting the trophy at Lord's? Get ready for fast-paced cricket action!

angles.copy: Lord's is hosting The Hundred Finals Day this weekend! If you're in London, it's a huge sporting event to catch. Who do you want to see win?

angles.name: Festival Vibe

angles.name: Immersive Experience

angles.copy: The Edinburgh Fringe is buzzing! What shows have you seen, or what hidden gems are you planning to discover before it wraps up?

angles.name: Scotland's Spotlight
angles.copy: Scotland's capital is alive with the arts! The Edinburgh Fringe Festival is bringing comedy, theatre, and music to the streets and venues all month long.

moments.title: The Weeknd at Wembley Stadium
moments.blurb: The Weeknd brings his record-breaking 'After Hours Til Dawn' tour to Wembley Stadium for five nights, starting Friday, August 14th.

angles.name: Wembley Weekend
angles.copy: The Weeknd takes over Wembley Stadium this Friday! Five nights of the 'After Hours Til Dawn' tour – who's got tickets for the biggest R&B stadium show ever?

angles.name: Anticipation
angles.copy: Get ready, London! The Weeknd is bringing his epic show to Wembley. What's the one song you're desperate to hear live?

moments.title: Ariana Grande's O2 Residency
moments.blurb: Ariana Grande begins her highly anticipated ten-night 'Eternal Sunshine Tour' residency at The O2 in London this Saturday, August 15th.

angles.name: Pop Queen Returns
angles.copy: Ariana Grande is back! Her 'Eternal Sunshine Tour' kicks off a massive ten-night residency at The O2 this Saturday. Who's seeing the pop icon?

angles.name: O2 Takeover
angles.copy: London's O2 is about to become Ariana Grande's home for ten nights! An extraordinary return to live performance – get ready for the 'Eternal Sunshine'!

moments.title: Mark Knopfler Turns 77
moments.blurb: Dire Straits frontman and legendary guitarist Mark Knopfler celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar Legend
angles.copy: Happy 77th Birthday to the iconic Mark Knopfler! His fingerstyle guitar and songwriting with Dire Straits gave us so many classics. What's your favourite Dire Straits track?

angles.name: Dire Straits
angles.copy: From 'Sultans of Swing' to 'Money for Nothing', Mark Knopfler's influence is undeniable. Celebrating his 77th birthday today!

moments.title: Larry Graham Turns 80
moments.blurb: Funk and soul bass legend Larry Graham, known for Sly and the Family Stone and Graham Central Station, celebrates his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Funk Icon
angles.copy: Happy 80th Birthday to the incredible Larry Graham! The bass pioneer from Sly and the Family Stone and Graham Central Station. His grooves are legendary!

angles.name: Bass Master
angles.copy: Celebrating Larry Graham's 80th today! A true innovator of funk bass. What's your favourite track featuring his iconic thumping style?

moments.title: Pat Metheny Turns 72
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning jazz guitarist and composer Pat Metheny celebrates his 72nd birthday today.

angles.name: Jazz Genius
angles.copy: Happy 72nd Birthday to the phenomenal jazz guitarist Pat Metheny! His innovative sound has captivated audiences for decades. What's your favourite Metheny album?

angles.name: Guitar Virtuoso
angles.copy: Celebrating the birthday of a true guitar virtuoso, Pat Metheny! Tune into his incredible compositions today.
